                    SOUTHWESTERN ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY’S
                 STATEMENT UNDER SECTION 4 OF PROTECTIVE ORDER

          Certain documents provided in response to Texas Industrial Energy Consumers’ (TIEC)

First Request for Information to Southwestern Electric Power Company (SWEPCO), Question

No. 1-1 are exempt from public disclosure pursuant to §§ 552.101 and 552.110 of the Public

Information Act1 and Tex. Util. Code § 32.101(c) and are subject to treatment as Confidential

materials.

          The attachment provided in response to TIEC’s Question No. 1-1 contains prices and

other information related to customer-specific contracts that are protected as highly sensitive

trade secrets.

          Counsel for SWEPCO has reviewed the documents sufficiently to state in good faith that

the documents are exempt from disclosure under the Public Information Act and merit the

Confidential designation given to them.
